text: A psalm of David. I Give to the Lord, you sons of God, [1]give to the Lord glory and might;
Give to the Lord the glory due his name.Bow down before the Lord's holy splendor! [AA]
II The voice of the Lord [2] is over the waters;the God of glory thunders,the Lord, over the mighty waters.
The voice of the Lord is power;the voice of the Lord is splendor. [AB]
The voice of the Lord cracks the cedars;the Lord splinters the cedars of Lebanon,
Makes Lebanon leap like a calf,and Sirion [3] like a young bull.
The voice of the Lord strikes with fiery flame;
the voice of the Lord shakes the desert;the Lord shakes the desert of Kadesh.
t[4]The voice of the Lord makes the deer danceand strips the forests bare.All in his Temple say, "Glory!"
III The Lord sits enthroned above the flood! [5] [AC]The Lord reigns as king forever!
May the Lord give might to his people; [6]may the Lord bless his people with peace! [AD]
